# ADR-3071: A06: Documented freeze window for release train 11

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Freezes delay patches intentionally.

## Decision

Programs MAY adopt a documented freeze window for release train 11 (A06-11) when stabilizing a major launch.

## Consequences

Critical CVE exceptions pierce freezes.
